handle_request_text_completion: handle a /v1/completions request with a raw text prompt and return streaming or non-streaming response
stream_text_completion_tokens: stream generated text tokens as server-sent events for a legacy completions endpoint
run_non_streaming_text_completion: run non-streaming text completion and return a JSONResponse with generated text and usage stats
build_generation_config_from_body: build a generation config by applying legacy completion params like max_tokens and frequency_penalty
build_sse_completion_chunk: build a streaming completion chunk and format it as an SSE data line for text generation
